prompt: Objective: find why on-time delivery fell from 95% to 80%. What you've learned: order volume is flat and carriers report normal transit times. Latest finding: warehouse processing time doubled after a new system launched. What is the best next step?

options.text: Check carrier transit times in more detail
options.feedback: That has already been answered. Build on what you know.

options.text: Analyze the client's pricing for more context on the business
options.feedback: That is off the objective. It won't help answer the client's question.

options.text: Find which warehouse step the new system slowed
options.feedback: Right. Processing time doubled, so the next step is to find which step in the warehouse slowed.

options.text: Recommend going back to the old system
options.feedback: That jumps to a solution before the analysis supports it.

explanation: Processing time doubled, so the next step is to find which step in the warehouse slowed.
